Thanks Olga — short answers below:

1) AP path: Yes, for new vendors we generally require a vendor record + PO. We run procurement through Coupa; typical vendor onboarding is 6–8 weeks.
2) Credit card: Finance allows corporate card charges under $5k for ad-hoc purchases, but anything recurring / SaaS goes through PO.
3) Marketplace: If the vendor is available on AWS Marketplace with consolidated billing, procurement is open to that route and onboarding is usually much faster.

Procurement contact: Leslie Cho (leslie.cho@sunridgeenergy.com). She handles vendor setup and will triage required docs. 

I attached the Coupa vendor checklist we share internally (Sunridge-Coupa-Notes.docx). Happy to join a quick sync with Leslie if helpful.

— Alex

Thanks for the flag — quick proposal from commercial/pricing perspective:

Option A — Marketplace-first (preferred)
- Enable an AWS Marketplace listing for a usage-based pilot SKU (we can publish a private listing or use consolidated billing).
- Pros: procurement can onboard in ~1–2 weeks, consolidated bill, easier procurement sign-off.
- Cons: takes ~3–5 business days to prepare SKU + legal review. Ops: need Platform & Legal to approve listing.

Option B — Invoice-first pilot while PO is being set up
- Offer a 90-day invoice-based pilot (one-time invoice for pilot), Redwood bills and Sunridge pays via ACH/Bank transfer.
- Pros: fastest to start, avoids Coupa wait time.
- Cons: finance uptake risk; requires commercial ops approval for invoice credit terms (we can request Net0 or Net15 for pilot).

Option C — Standard PO (Net30) for initial three-month PO
- If procurement insists on PO, provide Master Quote + Net30 terms. We should request an initial PO amount that covers the pilot (we can negotiate a capped spend).

Recommended next steps:
1) Olga: schedule 15-min intro with Leslie (procurement) and copy me.
2) Commercial: I’ll draft a one-page pilot quote for both invoice and PO routes (attaching Sunridge-Master-Quote.pdf).
3) Ops: check feasibility of private AWS Marketplace listing and lead time.

I’ll prepare the one-pager and a short legal checklist to speed procurement reviews. If Leslie is open to marketplace, that’s fastest. Otherwise invoice pilot is an acceptable workaround for a quick start.

— Ben
